citation.authors: Engeroff T, Heinsel K, Niederer D, Nienhaus A, Groneberg DA, Vogt L
citation.title: Investigating effects of FFP2 wearing during physical activity on gas exchange, metabolism and affective state using a randomized controlled trial

population.description: Thirteen healthy adults (6 female, 7 male; abstract and Results: 'Healthy adults'). Eligibility 18 to 50 years; excluded cardiovascular, pulmonary or advanced musculoskeletal disease; no medication except oral contraceptives. Age and BMI as printed in Table 1 (mean and SD). VO2max as printed in Table 1 (maximal values during the incremental exercise test, oxygen uptake ml/min/kg, whole group): 'Oxygen uptake ml/min/kg 47.2 7.6' (mean and SD).

protocols.name: seated_rest_no_mask
protocols.description: Seated rest without a mask: the 5 min rest before the first bout of a session (Methods: 'rested for five minutes in a seated position without wearing a FFP2'). Start clock hour not printed (trials at 'a comparable time of the day'); 12.0 assumed. No food or drink for 2 h before each visit, habitual diet otherwise, so the last meal is not stated: norm_center start, no meal. Rows: 'No mask' column of Table 2 (the FFP2 column is a second no-mask baseline on the other day, see left_out).

protocols.name: bout_40pct_no_mask
protocols.description: 40% VO2max cycling bout without a mask, 10 min, after the 5 min seated rest (Methods: bouts 'of 10 min' at 40, 50 and 70% of individual VO2max; 5 min rest without mask between bouts). Level from the group's printed VO2max, Table 1: 47.2 mL/kg/min x 0.40 = 18.88 mL/kg/min, level = (18.88 - 3.7) / 31.7 = 0.4789. The bouts were run in randomised order within a session, so the state left by an earlier bout is not modelled. Start clock hour not printed (12.0 assumed); no food or drink for 2 h before the visit, last meal not stated: norm_center, no meal.

protocols.description: 50% VO2max cycling bout without a mask, 10 min, after the 5 min seated rest (Methods: bouts 'of 10 min' at 40, 50 and 70% of individual VO2max; 5 min rest without mask between bouts). Level from the group's printed VO2max, Table 1: 47.2 mL/kg/min x 0.50 = 23.6 mL/kg/min, level = (23.6 - 3.7) / 31.7 = 0.6278. The bouts were run in randomised order within a session, so the state left by an earlier bout is not modelled. Start clock hour not printed (12.0 assumed); no food or drink for 2 h before the visit, last meal not stated: norm_center, no meal.

left_out.what: FFP2 mask worn during the 40, 50 and 70% VO2max bouts: the FFP2 columns of Table 3 (breathing frequency, ventilation, end-tidal gases, blood gases, RER, HR, breathing effort)
Baseline of the FFP2 day, Table 2 'FFP2' column: a second seated rest without a mask on the other trial day, the same 13 people, so it is not entered beside the 'No mask' rest
Ventilation (L/min) at rest (Table 2) and in each no-mask bout (Table 3)
Tidal volume (L) at rest (Table 2) and in each no-mask bout (Table 3)
Inspiration and exhalation time (s) at rest (Table 2) and in each no-mask bout (Table 3)
End-tidal CO2 and O2 partial pressures (mmHg) at rest (Table 2) and in each no-mask bout (Table 3)
Capillary blood pCO2, pO2, pH and base excess at rest (Table 2) and in each no-mask bout (Table 3)
Capillary lactate in each no-mask bout (Table 3): the paper does not say when the earlobe sample was drawn
Capillary lactate at rest (Table 2, no-mask column): resting lactate is outside the fed-state list (the last meal is not stated)
Respiratory exchange ratio at rest (Table 2) and in each no-mask bout (Table 3): RER depends on the meal, which is not stated
Perceived exertion (Borg 6-20) in each no-mask bout (Table 3)
Breathing effort (Borg CR-10) at rest (Table 2) and in each no-mask bout (Table 3)
Maximal values of the incremental cardiopulmonary test (Table 1: power 324 +/- 82 W, heart rate 175 +/- 11, RER 1.28 +/- 0.10); the VO2max of Table 1 is used as the intensity input, not entered
